operating_point.fold_gate_provenance: M-CSA baseline: fold>=0.65 -> 24/25=0.96 precision; off-M-CSA bronze recovery 132/156

critical_finding: Every one of the 112 confident off-M-CSA candidates is reviewed Swiss-Prot with 'Evidence at protein level' — i.e. already experimentally characterized. The annotation-anchored bronze pool contains NO unknown-function proteins, so it cannot yield a novel benchtop discovery target. It is a validation set, not a discovery set.

multi_cofactor_discovery.name: Flavo-diiron protein FprA2
multi_cofactor_discovery.suggested_assay: Assay BOTH activities: flavin-dependent NAD(P)H oxidation AND di-iron O2/NO reductase (FprA-type); confirm di-iron center spectroscopically.
multi_cofactor_discovery.insight: Fold channel matches a di-iron metallo-hydrolase fold (metallo-β-lactamase neighbor) while the cofactor channel calls flavin. The protein is a flavo-di-iron protein with BOTH a flavin and a di-iron site — the fold channel correctly surfaces a second catalytic module the cofactor label collapses.

caution_do_not_test.name: p-benzoquinone reductase
caution_do_not_test.suggested_assay: H2O2 decomposition (catalase, 240 nm) or peroxidase dye oxidation; heme (Soret ~405 nm) confirmation.
caution_do_not_test.insight: Fold matched a multidomain flavohemoprotein (cyt P450-BM3, P14779) and inherited its heme label, but these are flavin-only quinone reductases. Multidomain label-transfer artifact — NOT a lab target.

novel_target_next_step: For a genuinely novel (unknown-function) benchtop target, re-run the SAME engine over an UNCHARACTERIZED in-family pool (TrEMBL / 'Predicted'/'Inferred from homology' / no experimental EC), fetch AlphaFold structures, foldseek vs the M-CSA atlas, apply the same fold>=0.70 gate. That swap of input pool is the only missing step and is bounded.
